title: tdh.util.adsr.ui~
description: `tdh.util.adsr.ui~` is a GUI-controlled ADSR ramp generator for shaping values or audio amplitude, with both data-rate and signal-rate output. A gate value greater than 0 starts the attack and decay stages, while 0 triggers release; in MIDI-velocity mode, values from 0–127 also set the sustain level after conversion to linear amplitude.
